records.name: Eve
records.one_liner: A server-shaped durable agent framework: Workflow owns sessions and Eve drives an outer loop around single AI SDK steps.

features_notes.in_process_sdk: Authoring framework and HTTP clients; no public in-process session runner.
features_notes.os_sandbox: Provider-dependent microVM/container; just-bash fallback has no OS isolation and authored tools run in app runtime.
features_notes.durable_resume: Workflow World owns scheduling/persistence; interrupted steps may repeat inline effects.

dims.loop: Session/turn loops in Workflow; a durable step calls one-step ToolLoopAgent (batching is optional).
dims.providers: AI SDK model interface, direct providers and Gateway defaults.
dims.tools: File-discovered authored tools, workflow tools, MCP/OpenAPI and sandbox proxies.
dims.context: Instruction/skill directories, dynamic prompt/tool resolution and compaction.
dims.state: Workflow replay/checkpoints, parked waits and deployment handoff; repeated interrupted steps can repeat effects.
dims.safety: Ingress auth and identity-aware approvals; authored Node tools are trusted and bypass sandbox.
dims.extensibility: Npm extensions, directory conventions, registry, hooks, custom channels and providers.
dims.multi_agent: Durable local/remote/declarative tasks and workflow orchestration; no control-transfer handoffs.
dims.surfaces: Nitro server, HTTP clients, TUI/web/ACP/channels; not a standalone in-process harness API.
dims.observability: OTel, Agent Runs traces and integrated eval surfaces.

key_insights: A server-shaped durable agent framework: Workflow owns sessions and Eve drives an outer loop around single AI SDK steps.
Workflow replay/checkpoints, parked waits and deployment handoff; repeated interrupted steps can repeat effects.
Ingress auth and identity-aware approvals; authored Node tools are trusted and bypass sandbox.

checked_claims: ToolLoopAgent construction is capped at one step
Inline tools execute in app runtime
Workflow documentation states interrupted steps rerun
Approvals are authorization, not external-effect deduplication
corrections: Clarified approval does not prevent duplicate effects on crash replay
unresolved: Workflow World crash behavior is inherited and was not runtime-tested.
Dynamic beta launch/release statistics were not independently rechecked.
verification.scope: Static inspection of selected high-impact claims. Not an exhaustive claim audit; no cloned code executed. Manifest/loop/recovery/safety boundaries prioritized.
